question: Add a new method GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool) to the Host interface. Host provides access to the collector's shared resources. Jaeger and contrib extensions use Host to look up other extensions (e.g., storage, auth). All Host implementations must add this method.

files_to_modify.what: Add GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool) method to the Host interface
files_to_modify.why: This is the core Host interface definition. It currently defines GetExtensions() which returns all extensions as a map[ID]Component. The new GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool) method provides a direct lookup for a single extension by ID, returning the component and a boolean indicating whether it was found.

files_to_modify.what: Add GetExtension(id component.ID) (component.Component, bool) method to the nophost struct
files_to_modify.why: nophost is a no-op mock implementation of component.Host used in unit tests. It must satisfy the updated interface. The implementation should return nil, false (no extensions in a nop host).

files_to_modify.what: Add GetExtension(id component.ID) (component.Component, bool) method to the host struct
files_to_modify.why: This is the main production Host implementation in the collector service. It manages extensions, pipelines, and component lifecycle. It already has GetExtensions() returning the full map. GetExtension should look up a single extension by ID from its internal extensions map and return (component, true) if found or (nil, false) if not.

files_to_modify.what: Add GetExtension(id component.ID) (component.Component, bool) method to the mockhost struct
files_to_modify.why: mockhost is a test mock for exporter helper tests. It implements component.Host with a controlled set of extensions. GetExtension should look up by ID in its internal extensions map.

interface_change.description: The Host interface currently only exposes GetExtensions() which returns the full map of all registered extensions. The new GetExtension(id ID) method allows direct lookup of a single extension by its component.ID, returning the Component and a boolean indicating presence. This eliminates the need for callers (like Jaeger's findExtension or contrib auth extensions) to first call GetExtensions() and then manually search the map.

implementations_requiring_update.implementation_logic: Return nil, false — nop host has no extensions
Look up id in internal extensions map, return (ext, true) if found, (nil, false) if not
Look up id in mock extensions map, return (ext, true) if found, (nil, false) if not

jaeger.description: Jaeger's findExtension and GetExtension helper functions currently call host.GetExtensions() and iterate the map to find a specific extension by ID. With GetExtension(id) on Host, these helpers can be simplified to a single host.GetExtension(id) call.

contrib.description: Many contrib extensions (auth, storage, encoding) look up other extensions via host.GetExtensions() map iteration. They can be simplified to use the new direct GetExtension(id) method.
